import.description: Seed and correct African countries, ISO 3166-2 subdivisions, currency precision and (when enabled) administrative divisions. Safe to run repeatedly — it never duplicates or overwrites records you have marked as overridden.
import.error: Reference-data import failed. Check the logs.
import.missingHint: Some African currencies are not installed. Create them under Settings > Currencies with a real exchange factor, then run the import again to correct their precision.
import.disabled: Reference data is disabled in the Features card. Enable it to run the import.
